description: The line plot illustrates the maximum activation value across different layers for four network components. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 23, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Max Activation Value" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1600, with tick marks at intervals of 200. The plot contains four lines, none of which utilize markers. The "attn_output" line is blue and dashed; it begins at approximately 0 at layer 0, remains near 0 across most of the x-axis, and rises to roughly 250 at layer 23. The "attn_residual" line is orange and dotted; it starts near 0 at layer 0, remains low until layer 5, and then sharply increases to approximately 1400 at layer 6. It continues to rise to about 1580 by layer 14, maintains this steady high value until layer 21, and then sharply declines to roughly 250 at layer 23. The "ffn_output" line is green and dash-dotted; it starts near 0 at layer 0, exhibits a sharp peak of approximately 1400 at layer 5, and immediately drops back near 0 at layer 6. It shows another peak of roughly 1000 at layer 13, drops back near 0 at layer 14, and exhibits a final peak of approximately 1180 at layer 22 before ending at roughly 550 at layer 23. Finally, the "ffn_residual" line is red and solid; it begins near 0 at layer 0, stays low until layer 4, and sharply rises to approximately 1400 at layer 5. It increases to about 1480 at layer 7, remains steady until layer 12, rises to roughly 1580 by layer 14, and stays steady until layer 20. It then drops sharply to approximately 390 at layer 22 before ending at roughly 620 at layer 23.
